limitations: Exact React Native Android source snapshot only; creation invokes native mnemonicNew and displays its 24-word result before backup confirmation. Derivation uses mnemonicToWalletKey.
Hardware/Ledger, imported accounts, iOS binaries and other app versions are not covered by this profile. Wallet contract version changes do not establish mnemonic changes.
guidance: Use the original trusted wallet's backup and recovery procedure. Match exact product, platform, source version and mode. Never enter a complete recovery phrase into Tessaveil or a website.
